title: Raw rational localization of fixed ring-stage operations
statement: Fix a prime l, a chosen algebraic closure Ω of Q_l, a finite-field datum D with l != D.p, finite-type D.k-schemes X,Y and a separated finite-type D.k-morphism f, without absolute separatedness of X or Y. Let A be the supplied RingStageAssembly [def-sf-ring-stage-assembly-data], and suppose its integral left and right functors are coefficient-DVR-linear. There exists RationalStageAssembly A: rational operations at each c,E, their prescribed compact-support left realization, counit-normalized localization and rational scalar comparisons, the raw localized action on integral objects and arrows, localization shifts independent of c, and localization q equal to the identity on every raw integral object. Rational scalar q is exactly the localization of A.comparison. No closed operation, common-field comparison or refinement is an output. RationalStageAssembly.fields merely inserts these rational comparisons into A.complete for any later supplied closed operations.

source.place: Construction 6.2 after Lemma 5.22 and Proposition 5.24; coefficient construction step 5, raw localization of a fixed supplied integral adjunction only

proof.text: For each endpoint T, map the prime unit of the finite base field through global sections, germs and the residue map. Thus l is invertible in every residue field. Apply integral_residue_tor to get equality of the full integral and finite-Tor predicates, including for empty schemes.

For each compactification c and field E, apply the single-adjunction raw localization theorem to A.operation c (.integral E). The two rational functors have the explicit base-changed Hom maps. Choose only their adjunction and exact structures and their identity localization comparisons. Both endpoint shifts are fixed independently of c.

Construct the rational-left realization explicitly. At the representative K it is Q(A.integralLeft.app K). On a pure tensor a tensor h, naturality reduces to a tensor the naturality equation of A.integralLeft; both tensor composition formulas are already proved. Tensor induction handles zero and sums. The inverse equations follow because these are localized integral isomorphisms. The localization-normalized equation follows from identity q and this component formula.

For every coefficient embedding apply the single-mate localization theorem to the supplied A.scalar and A.comparison, using A.integralScalar_eq. This gives exactly the required rational scalar component equation. No proper/open normalization or cocycle is needed because the given mate is localized as it stands.

Package the rational operations, the constructed left realizations, and the two sorts of comparisons. On each integral object the raw rational functor is literally the localized old image. On integral arrows its base-changed Hom map at 1 tensor h is 1 tensor F(h). This proves localizedAction. Equality with the fixed endpoint shifts proves shift independence, and the single-adjunction comparison provides identity q.

proof_origin.place: Constructions 6.1 and 6.2, raw tensor localization of the supplied integral adjunction and its supplied scalar mate; compact-support realization constructed by tensor induction in Lean (M6).

theorem exists_rational_stage_localization
    (A : RingStageAssembly.{u, v} l Ω D hl (f := f))
    (_leftLinear : ∀ (c : Compactification f) (E : FieldStage.{max u v} l),
      (A.operation c (.integral E)).F.Linear (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E.carrier))
    (_rightLinear : ∀ (c : Compactification f) (E : FieldStage.{max u v} l),
      (A.operation c (.integral E)).G.Linear (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E.carrier)) :
    Nonempty (RationalStageAssembly.{u, v} l Ω D hl A)
